initial_task:
TASK-MCP-005 - CLI DEVELOPMENT TESTING
Project: Templum
Folder Path: .claude/handoff/chain-design/2025-09-12-113834-TASK-MCP-005

*DESIGN CHAIN USING v1.4 SPEED-OPTIMIZED APPROACH*
Prioritize rapid execution and delivery.

Task Context:
- Work out CLI requirements (how it should work, display, controls/keybindings, functionality)
- Create a non-technical user-focused spec file for the CLI
- Work out whether current CLI meets those requirements
- Work out how to make sure it meets requirements (using patterns)
- Implement necessary changes
- Validate the implemented changes (ValidationSystem + MANUAL testing via MCP)
- Iterate until it works
- Document the fix and patterns

Key Constraint: This task should be completed by utilizing the MCP and CLI, NOT by writing new scripts/test files. This is a test of the ability to use the CLI and develop Templum by agent use of the CLI.

task_specifications.task_description: Analyze current Templum CLI functionality, assess user requirements for controls, display, keybindings, and core functionality. Document existing state and define user-centric requirements.
Create comprehensive non-technical user-focused CLI specification document based on requirements analysis, focusing on user experience and expected behaviors.
Perform detailed gap analysis between current CLI implementation and requirements, identify specific implementation changes needed using established patterns.
Implement necessary CLI changes using MCP tools and existing CLI infrastructure only (no new scripts/test files). Focus on core functionality improvements.
Validate CLI changes using ValidationSystem and manual testing via MCP, iterate if needed, document patterns and fixes for future reference.
